questions.question: After David finished offering sacrifices before the ark of God, what did he do?

answers.text: He blessed the people in the name of the LORD
He read the Law of Moses to the people
He led the people on a march through the city

questions.question: After the ark came to its tent, David gave bread and cakes only to the Levites. True or false?
In David's song, God made a covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. What did He promise to give them?
In David's song of thanksgiving, why is the LORD to be feared above all gods?

answers.text: Other gods are idols but He made the heavens
Other gods are new but He was there first
